# Project Setup

```{r}
#| label:  setup

cran <- c("parallel", "sommer")
git <- c("hemstrow/snpR") # https://github.com/hemstrow/snpR

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  for (pkg in cran) { 
    if( !require(pkg, character.only = TRUE) ) {
      install.packages(pkg)
      library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
    } 
  }
  
  for (pkg in git) {
    if( !require(sub(".*/", "", pkg), character.only = TRUE) ) {
      pak::pkg_install(pkg, upgrade = TRUE)
      library(sub(".*/", "", pkg), character.only = TRUE)
    }
  }
}); remove(cran, git, pkg)

# pak::pkg_install("hemstrow/snpR")

ncores <- floor(parallel::detectCores()*0.8)
set.seed(2025)

library(rrBLUP)
library(vcfR)
library(data.table)
library(rsample)
library(gtsummary)

source('https://inkaverse.com/setup.r')
```

For the large files was created a `xclude` folder and add the name to the `.gitignore` to avoid upload files saved in this folder to the server

# Phenotypic data

```{r}
url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1WQKAOnxO9on7YoF9yC2WV7eHcChZJ5FR6DVyg0tJK1o/edit#gid=0"
gs <- url %>% as_sheets_id()

fb <- gs %>%
  range_read("STable2") %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c(trial, pop, num, type)) %>% 
  separate_wider_delim(line
                       , delim = "_"
                       , names = c("cross", "nline")
                       , cols_remove = FALSE
                       , too_few = "align_start"
                       ) %>% 
  mutate(pop = case_when(
    str_detect(cross, "SALx", ) ~ "SAL"
    , str_detect(cross, "xKAN", ) ~ "KAN"
    , .default = cross
  ), .before = "cross")
  

fb %>% web_table(caption = "Phenotypic data")

traits <- gs %>%
  range_read("STable1") %>% 
  mutate(trait = paste0(traits, " ", "(", units, ")", "\nstage: ", phenology))

traitnames <- traits %>% dplyr::select(abbreviations, trait) %>% deframe()
```

```{r}
fbdist <- fb %>% 
  drop_na(nline) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!c(pop:line), names_to = "trait") %>% 
  separate_wider_delim(trait
                       , delim = "_"
                       , names = c("variable", "phenology")
                       , cols_remove = FALSE
                       ) %>% 
  mutate(label = dplyr::recode(trait, !!!traitnames))

fbdist$trait %>% unique() %>% dput()

order <- c("ndflw_flw"
           , "plth_flw"
           , "pnlg_flw", "pnwd_flw"
           , "ndpm_mtr"
           , "plth_mtr"
           , "pnlg_mtr", "pnwd_mtr"
           , "mstd_mtr"
           , "sdyp_hrv", "yplt_hrv", "wl_mtr")

lb <- fbdist %>% 
  dplyr::select(trait, label) %>% 
  dplyr::distinct() %>% 
  deframe()

dist <- fbdist %>% 
  mutate(trait = factor(trait, levels = order)) %>%

  plot_raw(type = "box"

dist$layers[[1]] <- NULL
dist$layers[[1]] <- NULL

fig <- dist %>%

          , units = "cm", width = 35, height = 15)

fig %>% include_graphics()
```

# Genotypic data

Genotypic data is in a BCF file which has more than 2 Gb large and harbors >900.000 SNPs. In order to keep the running times manageable, the number of SNPs has to be reduce.

The snp pruning were performed in the server of the Crop Biodiversity and Breeding Informatics groups at University of Hohenheim.

```{bash}
#| eval: false

ssh flaaw57@server231.ipsp.uni-hohenheim.de
cd /work/workspaces/novogene-sequencing-job-2021/vcfs/
cd /work/workspaces/flavio/quinoagenetics/

# -e stands for "exclude." It removes variants that meet the specified condition.
# F_MISSING refers to the fraction of missing data at a variant site.
# > 0.8 means any variants where more than 50% of the data are missing will be excluded (filtered out).

bcftools filter -e 'F_MISSING > 0.8' -O z xclude/quinoa_run1_all.bcf > xclude/quinoa_0.8.vcf.gz

# export names to rename
bcftools query -l xclude/quinoa_0.8.vcf.gz > xclude/genotype_names.txt
```

## Genotypes names to rename vcf file

```{r}
#| eval: false

vcf.names <- "xclude/genotype_names.txt" %>% 
  read.csv(header = F, col.names = "name_old") %>% 
  mutate(pmatch = toupper(name_old)) %>% 
  mutate(match = gsub(".*A(.+)_F.*", "\\1", pmatch)) %>% 
  select(!pmatch)

geno.names <- "genetics/genotype-names.csv" %>% 
  read.csv() %>% 
  unite(match, c(plots, crossn, line), remove = F, sep = "_") %>% 
  mutate(name_new = case_when(
    cross %in% c("SAL", "PAN", "HUA", "KCA", "COL", "BDJ", "CHU", "AYR", "CHO", "PAS") ~  as.character(paste(cross, line, crossn, sep = "_"))
    , TRUE ~ as.character(paste(cross, line, sep = "_"))
  )) %>% 
  select(match, name_new) %>% 
  distinct(name_new, .keep_all = T)

vcf.rename <- merge(vcf.names, geno.names, by = "match", all.x = T) %>% 
  mutate(name_new = case_when(
    is.na(name_new) ~ name_old
    , TRUE ~ name_new
  )) %>% 
  select(!match) %>% 
  mutate(name_new = gsub("KCA", "KAN", name_new)) %>% 
  mutate(name_new = gsub("COL", "NCO", name_new))

tab <- vcf.rename %>% 
  distinct(name_new) 

vcf.rename %>% write_tsv("genetics/vcf.rename.txt")
```

## Rename VCF file

```{bash}
#| eval: false

bcftools reheader -s genetics/vcf.rename.txt xclude/quinoa_0.8.vcf.gz > xclude/quinoa_0.8_rhd.vcf.gz

# check rename
bcftools query -l xclude/quinoa_0.8_rhd.vcf.gz
```

## Filter by Population

```{bash}
#| eval: false

bcftools query -l xclude/quinoa_0.8_rhd.vcf.gz > genetics/genotype_renamed.txt
cat genetics/genotype_renamed.txt

# Filter NAM populations for SAL and KAN

grep -E "SALx|xKAN" genetics/genotype_renamed.txt > genetics/populations.txt
cat populations.txt

# SNPs for all populations

bcftools view -S genetics/populations.txt xclude/quinoa_0.8_rhd.vcf.gz > xclude/quinoa_pops.vcf.gz
```

# snpR

> https://www.nature.com/articles/s41576-024-00738-6/tables/1
> https://doi.org/10.1111/1755-0998.13721

```{r}
# vcffile <- choose.files()

vcfile <- "xclude/quinoa_pops.vcf.gz"

snpdt <- snpR::read_vcf(file = vcfile)
snpdt

sample_meta <- snpdt %>% 
  names() %>% 
  gsub("_.*", "", .) %>% 
  enframe(value = "cross") %>% 
  mutate(pop = case_when(
    str_detect(cross, "xKAN") ~ "KAN"
    , str_detect(cross, "KAN") ~ "KAN"
    , str_detect(cross, "SALx") ~ "SAL"
    , str_detect(cross, "SAL") ~ "SAL"
  ))
  
sample.meta(snpdt)$cross <- factor(sample_meta$cross
                                   , levels = c("HUAxKAN", "NCOxKAN", "PASxKAN"
                                                , "SALxHUA", "SALxNCO", "SALxPAN"))
sample.meta(snpdt)$pop <- sample_meta$pop

sample.meta(snpdt)
snp.meta(snpdt)
```

# Clean genotyping data

```{r}
# SNP filtering for population structure analyses
# Based on Hemstrom et al. (2024)

snpdt_filt <- snpR::filter_snps(
  x = snpdt
  , maf = 0.05           # Retain SNPs with MAF ≥ 5%
  , min_ind = 0.50       # SNPs genotyped in ≥50% of individuals
  , min_loci = 0.50      # Individuals genotyped at ≥50% of SNPs
  , maf_facets = "cross" # Evaluate MAF within each NAM cross
)

# Inspect applied filters
snpR::filters(snpdt_filt)
```

# Sequencing depth

```{r}

library(vcfR)
library(tidyverse)

# Leer archivo VCF
vcf <- read.vcfR("xclude/quinoa_0.8_rhd.vcf.gz")

# Extraer profundidad de cobertura (DP)
dp <- extract.gt(vcf, element = "DP", as.numeric = TRUE) %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("marker") %>% 
  pivot_longer(!marker, values_to = "dp") %>%

ggplot(dp, aes(x = dp)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), n.breaks = 20, limits = c(0, 40)) +
```

## Population structure

```{r}
popstr_k <- snpR::plot_structure(x = snpdt_filt
                               , facet = "cross"
                               , k = 2:10
                               , method = "snmf"
                               , reps = 20
                               , clumpp = FALSE
                               , clumpp_path = "C:/CLUMPP/CLUMPP.exe"
                               )

plot_sfa <- popstr_k$plot

# Calcular la entropía cruzada promedio y desviación estándar por cada K
k_summary <- popstr_k$K_plot %>%
  group_by(k) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_entropy = mean(Cross.Entropy, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_entropy = sd(Cross.Entropy, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Visualizar la curva de entropía cruzada
plot_sfb <- ggplot(k_summary, aes(x = k, y = mean_entropy)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Optimal K value selection with sNMF",
    x = "Number of clusters (K)",
    y = "Mean cross-entropy"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = k_summary$k) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

list(plot_sfa + 
       scale_fill_brewer(type = "qual", palette = "Paired") + 
       theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.box = "horizontal"
      )
     , plot_sfb 
     ) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.3)) %>% 
  ggsave2(plot = ., "manuscript/SFigure-01.jpg"
                 , width = 35, height = 30, units = "cm")

popstr <- snpR::plot_structure(x = snpdt_filt
                               , facet = "cross"
                               , k = 3
                               , method = "snmf"
                               , clumpp = FALSE
                               , reps = 1
                               )

p1b <- popstr$plot +
  scale_fill_brewer(type = "qua", palette = "Accent")

p1b
```

## LD decay

```{bash}
# vcf to bed

plink2 \
    --vcf genetics/pops/nam_SAL.vcf \
    --allow-extra-chr \
    --double-id \
    --make-bed \
    --out genetics/pops/SAL
    
plink2 \
    --vcf genetics/pops/nam_KAN.vcf \
    --allow-extra-chr \
    --double-id \
    --make-bed \
    --out genetics/pops/KAN

# LD calculation

plink2 \
    --bfile genetics/pops/SAL \
    --allow-extra-chr \
    --r2-unphased \
    --ld-window 99999 \
    --ld-window-kb 10000 \
    --ld-window-r2 0 \
    --out genetics/pops/SAL_LD

plink2 \
    --bfile genetics/pops/KAN \
    --allow-extra-chr \
    --r2-unphased \
    --ld-window 99999 \
    --ld-window-kb 10000 \
    --ld-window-r2 0 \
    --out genetics/pops/KAN_LD
```

```{r}
##----------------------------
## Read LD files
##----------------------------

ld_sal <- read_table("genetics/pops/SAL_LD.vcor",
                     show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    mutate(pop = "SAL")

ld_kan <- read_table("genetics/pops/KAN_LD.vcor",
                     show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    mutate(pop = "KAN")

ld <- bind_rows(ld_sal, ld_kan)

##----------------------------
## Distance
##----------------------------

ld <- ld %>% 
    mutate(distance = abs(POS_B - POS_A))

##----------------------------
## Remove different chromosomes
##----------------------------

ld <- ld %>% 
    filter(`#CHROM_A` == CHROM_B)

##----------------------------
## Create bins
##----------------------------

bin_size <- 50000   # 50 kb

ld <- ld %>% 
    mutate(bin = floor(distance/bin_size)*bin_size)

##----------------------------
## Mean LD
##----------------------------

ld_summary <- ld %>% 
    group_by(pop, bin) %>% 
    summarise(
        mean_r2 = mean(UNPHASED_R2, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_r2 = median(UNPHASED_R2, na.rm = TRUE),
        n = n(),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% 
    filter(n >= 50)

ggplot(ld_summary,
       aes(bin/1000,
           mean_r2,
           colour = pop))+

    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2)+

    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.2,
               linetype = 2)+

    labs(x="Physical distance (kb)",
         y=expression(r^2),
         colour="Population")+

    theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```

## Diversity indices

```{r}
# cross

snpdt_filt <- calc_pi(snpdt_filt, "cross")
snpdt_filt <- calc_ho(snpdt_filt, "cross")
snpdt_filt <- calc_he(snpdt_filt, "cross")
snpdt_filt <- calc_fis(snpdt_filt, "cross")
snpdt_filt <- calc_prop_poly(snpdt_filt, "cross")

stats <- get.snpR.stats(snpdt_filt, "cross"
                        , stats = c("pi", "he", "ho", "fis", "prop_poly"))

tab_cross <- stats$weighted.means %>% 
  dplyr::select(subfacet, matches("weighted|prop")) %>% 
  rename_with(~ gsub("weighted_mean_", "", .)) %>% 
  rename("Population" = subfacet) %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 2)))

# NAM

snpdt_filt <- calc_pi(snpdt_filt, "pop")
snpdt_filt <- calc_ho(snpdt_filt, "pop")
snpdt_filt <- calc_he(snpdt_filt, "pop")
snpdt_filt <- calc_fis(snpdt_filt, "pop")
snpdt_filt <- calc_prop_poly(snpdt_filt, "pop")

stats <- get.snpR.stats(snpdt_filt, "pop"
                        , stats = c("pi", "he", "ho", "fis", "prop_poly"))

tab_nam <- stats$weighted.means %>% 
  dplyr::select(subfacet, matches("weighted|prop")) %>% 
  rename_with(~ gsub("weighted_mean_", "", .)) %>% 
  rename("Population" = subfacet) %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 2)))

tab <- list(tab_nam, tab_cross)  %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 
  tibble::add_row(Population = "NAM", .before = 1) %>%
  tibble::add_row(Population = "Cross", .before = 4) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(poly = "prop_poly") %>% 
  dplyr::select(!pi) %>% 
  mutate(n = c(NA, 59, 59, NA, 17, 21, 21, 16, 24, 19)) %>% 
  rename(Ho = ho, He = he, FIS = fis)

tab %>% kable()
  
# tab %>% googlesheets4::sheet_write(ss = gs, "Table1")

#> genetic distance

snpdt_filt <- calc_genetic_distances(snpdt_filt, "cross")
get.snpR.stats(snpdt_filt, "cross", "genetic_distance")
```

# Specific Objective 2

> rMVP: Memory-efficient, Visualization-enhanced, and Parallel-accelerated Genome-Wide Association Study

- https://github.com/xiaolei-lab/rMVP
- https://github.com/YinLiLin/CMplot

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(NAM)
library(vcfR)
library(CMplot)
library(rMVP)
```

### SALCEDO NAM

```{r}
pheno <- fb %>% 
  filter(grepl("SALx", line)) %>%
  dplyr::select(!c(pop, cross, nline)) %>%
  write_csv("genetics//mlt-sal.csv")

MVP.Data(fileVCF = "genetics/pops/nam_SAL.vcf"
         , filePhe = "genetics/mlt-sal.csv"
         , sep.phe = ","
         , priority = "speed"
         , fileKin = FALSE
         , filePC = FALSE
         , out = "genetics/rmvp/dt_sal"
         , ncpus = ncores
         )
```

### Kinship

```{r}
MVP.Data.Kin(fileKin = TRUE
             , mvp_prefix = 'genetics/rmvp/dt_sal'
             , out = 'genetics/rmvp/kin_sal')
```

### Data input

```{r}
genotype <- attach.big.matrix("genetics/rmvp/dt_sal.geno.desc")
phenotype <- read.table("genetics/rmvp/dt_sal.phe", head = TRUE)
mapping <- read.table("genetics/rmvp/dt_sal.geno.map", head = TRUE)
kinship <- attach.big.matrix("genetics/rmvp/kin_sal.kin.desc")
```

##  GWAS

```{r}
mvp <- 2:length(phenotype) %>% map(\(x) {
  
  gc()  
  
  MVP(phe = phenotype %>% dplyr::select(1, all_of(x))
    , geno = genotype
    , map = mapping
    , K = kinship
    , vc.method = "EMMA"
    , method = c("FarmCPU")
    , maxLoop = 20
    , outpath = "genetics/gwas/"
    , file.output = FALSE
    , file.type = "csv"
    , ncpus = ncores
    )
})

# FarmCPU p-values 

gwas_sal <- 1:length(mvp) %>% map(\(x) {
  
  bind_cols(mvp[[x]]$map, mvp[[x]]$farmcpu.results) %>% 
    dplyr::select(!c(Effect, SE)) %>% 
    rownames_to_column()
  
}) %>% 
  Reduce(function(...) merge(..., all = TRUE), .) %>% 
  arrange(as.numeric(rowname)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c(rowname, MAF, A1, A2)) %>% 
  rename_with(~ gsub(".FarmCPU", "-SAL", .))
```

### Kinship

```{r}
MVP.Data.Kin(fileKin = TRUE
             , mvp_prefix = 'genetics/rmvp/dt_kan'
             , out = 'genetics/rmvp/kin_kan')
```

### Data input

```{r}
genotype <- attach.big.matrix("genetics/rmvp/dt_kan.geno.desc")
phenotype <- read.table("genetics/rmvp/dt_kan.phe", head = TRUE)
mapping <- read.table("genetics/rmvp/dt_kan.geno.map", head = TRUE)
kinship <- attach.big.matrix("genetics/rmvp/kin_kan.kin.desc")
```

##  GWAS

```{r}
mvp <- 2:length(phenotype) %>% map(\(x) {
  
  gc()  
  
  MVP(phe = phenotype %>% dplyr::select(1, all_of(x))
    , geno = genotype
    , map = mapping
    , K = kinship
    , vc.method = "EMMA"
    , method = c("FarmCPU")
    , maxLoop = 20
    , outpath = "genetics/gwas/"
    , file.output = FALSE
    , file.type = "csv"
    , ncpus = ncores
    )
    
})

# FarmCPU p-values 

gwas_kan <- 1:length(mvp) %>% map(\(x) {
  
  bind_cols(mvp[[x]]$map, mvp[[x]]$farmcpu.results) %>% 
    dplyr::select(!c(Effect, SE)) %>% 
    rownames_to_column()
  
}) %>% 
  Reduce(function(...) merge(..., all = TRUE), .) %>% 
  arrange(as.numeric(rowname)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c(rowname, MAF, A1, A2)) %>% 
  rename_with(~ gsub(".FarmCPU", "-KAN", .))
```

## Merge GWAS NAM populations

```{r}
gwas_rmvp <- base::merge(x = gwas_sal, y = gwas_kan
                  , by = c("SNP", "CHROM", "POS")
                  ) %>% arrange(CHROM)

alpha_bon <- 0.05/6054 # Bonferroni

qtl <- gwas_rmvp %>% 
  pivot_longer(!c(1:POS), values_to = "p-value") %>% 
  separate(name, c("Trait", "Population"), sep = "-") %>% 
  arrange(Trait, Population) %>% 
  mutate(log10 = -log10(`p-value`)) %>% 
  mutate(alpha = case_when(
    `p-value` <= alpha_bon ~ "Bonferroni"
  )) %>% 
  drop_na(alpha) %>% 
  mutate(Trait = dplyr::recode(Trait, !!!traitnames))
  
qtl %>% kable()

qtl %>% 
  group_by(Population) %>% 
  summarise(n = n())

qtl %>% 
  group_by(Trait, Population) %>% 
  summarise(n = n())
```

# NAM: Nested Association Mapping

> https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/NAM/index.html

## SALCEDO NAM

```{r}
pheno <- fb %>% 
  filter(grepl("SALx", line))

vcfdt  <- "genetics/pops/nam_SAL.vcf" %>% 
  vcfR::read.vcfR()

info <- vcfdt %>% 
  vcfR::getFIX() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(across(ID, ~ gsub("_", "",. ))) %>% 
  rowid_to_column()

chr <- info %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(chrome = gsub(".*([0-9]+[A-Z]+).*", "\\1", CHROM)) %>% 
  group_by(chrome) %>% 
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  deframe()
  
gwsdt <- vcfdt %>% 
  extract.gt() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(.), ~ case_when(
    . %in% "1/1" ~ 2
    , . %in% "0/1" ~ 1
    , . %in% "1/0" ~ 1
    , . %in% "0/0" ~ 0
  ))) %>% 
  rownames_to_column() %>% 
  arrange(rowname) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!rowname, names_to = "geno", values_to = "col") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "rowname", values_from = "col") %>% 
  separate(geno, c("family", "line"), remove = F) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!line) %>% 
  mutate(fam = case_when(
    family %in% "SALxPAN" ~ 1
    , family %in% "SALxNCO" ~ 2
    , family %in% "SALxHUA" ~ 3
  ), .after = family) %>% 
  merge(., pheno, by.x = "geno", by.y = "line")

rsl <- (length(gwsdt) - 11):length(gwsdt) %>% map(\(x) {
  
  trait <- gwsdt[x]
  
  nam_gwas = gwas(y = trait
                , gen = gwsdt %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("SNP_"))
                , fam = gwsdt$fam
                , chr = chr
                )
  
  plot(nam_gwas, alpha = alpha_bon
         , main = names(trait)
         ) %>% print
  
  nam_gwas$PolyTest %>% mutate(trait = names(trait)) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("ID")
  
}) 

gwas_sal_nam <- rsl %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 
  dplyr::select(ID, pval, trait) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = trait, values_from = pval) %>% 
  base::merge(info, ., by = "ID") %>% 
  arrange(rowid) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c(rowid, REF:FILTER))
```

```{r}
# if(!requireNamespace("BiocManager")) install.packages("BiocManager")

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)

# browseURL("https://genomevolution.org/coge/GenomeInfo.pl?gid=60716")

gff <- BiocIO::import("genetics/quinoa_QQ74.gff3")

qtl

gr_snps <- GRanges(
  seqnames = qtl$CHROM,
  ranges = IRanges(start = qtl$POS,
                   end = qtl$POS),
  SNP = qtl$SNP
)

window_size <- 100000 # ±100 kb

gr_windows <- resize(gr_snps,
                     width = window_size*2 + 1,
                     fix = "center")

hits <- findOverlaps(gr_windows, genes)

candidate_genes <- data.frame(
  SNP = gr_windows$SNP[queryHits(hits)],
  gene_id = genes$ID[subjectHits(hits)],
  CHROM = seqnames(genes)[subjectHits(hits)],
  gene_start = start(genes)[subjectHits(hits)],
  gene_end = end(genes)[subjectHits(hits)],
  annotation = genes$note[subjectHits(hits)]
) %>% 
  drop_na(annotation)

candidate_genes %>% kable()

trait2gene <- base::merge(candidate_genes, qtl) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Trait, Population, SNP, CHROM
                , gene_id, 
                , POS
                , gene_start
                , gene_end
                , annotation
                , !c(`p-value`, log10, alpha)
                ) %>% 
  arrange(CHROM, Trait)

qtl$SNP %>% length() 
trait2gene$SNP %>% factor() %>% nlevels()
```

```{r}
set.seed(as.numeric(1989-19-08))
```

```{r}
library(snpR)
library(tidyverse)

vcfile <- "genetics/pops/quinoa.vcf"

snpdt <- snpR::read_vcf(file = vcfile)
snpdt

sample_meta <- snpdt %>% 
  names() %>% 
  gsub("_.*", "", .) %>% 
  enframe(value = "cross") %>% 
  mutate(pop = case_when(
    str_detect(cross, "xKAN") ~ "KAN"
    , str_detect(cross, "KAN") ~ "KAN"
    , str_detect(cross, "SALx") ~ "SAL"
    , str_detect(cross, "SAL") ~ "SAL"
  ))
  
sample.meta(snpdt)$cross <- factor(sample_meta$cross
                                   , levels = c("HUAxKAN", "NCOxKAN", "PASxKAN"
                                                , "SALxHUA", "SALxNCO", "SALxPAN"))
sample.meta(snpdt)$pop <- sample_meta$pop

sample.meta(snpdt)
snp.meta(snpdt)

vcfdt <- format_snps(x = snpdt
                     , output = "sn"
                     , interpolate = ""
                     , chr = "CHROM"
                     , position = "position"
                     , facets = "pop"
                     , verbose = TRUE
                     # , outfile = "genetics/pops/nam"
                     ) %>% 
  mutate(ID = paste0("marker", "_", row.names(.))) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(1:FILTER)
               , names_to = "cross"
               , values_to = "gt"
               ) 

genotyping <- vcfdt %>%
  dplyr::select(id = cross, marker = ID, alleles = gt) %>% 
  mutate(alleles = case_when(
    alleles %in% 0 ~ "-1"
    , alleles %in% 1 ~ "0"
    , alleles %in% 2 ~ "1"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(across(alleles, ~ as.numeric(.))) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = marker
              , values_from = alleles)
```

# KAN Genomic Prediction

```{r}
geno <- genotyping %>% 
  filter(str_detect(id, "xKAN")) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("id")
  
pheno <- "genetics/mlt-kan.csv" %>% 
  read.csv(.) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(genotypes = line)
```

## Impute missing values

```{r}
# A.mat() can perform imputation as part of its relationship matrix calculation.
# However, for direct marker-based prediction (RR-BLUP), pre-imputation is
# often done. We can use the 'mean' method for a simple imputation strategy.

imputed_markers <- A.mat(geno
                         , max.missing = 0.5
                         , impute.method = "mean"
                         , return.imputed = T) %>% 
  pluck("imputed")
```

## Check data

```{r}
# Ensure sample IDs match in both genotype and phenotype data
common_samples <- intersect(rownames(imputed_markers), pheno$geno)
imputed_markers <- imputed_markers[common_samples, ]

phenotyping4gp <- pheno[pheno$geno %in% common_samples, ] %>% 
  tibble(.) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("genotypes")

traits <- colnames(phenotyping4gp)[1:length(phenotyping4gp)]
```

## Itinerations

```{r}
run_iteration <- function(trait, rep, data = phenotyping4gp) {
  # Split 60/40
  split_data <- initial_split(data, prop = 0.6)

  pheno_train <- training(split_data) %>% as.matrix()
  pheno_valid <- testing(split_data)  %>% as.matrix()

  geno_train <- imputed_markers[row.names(pheno_train), ]
  geno_valid <- imputed_markers[row.names(pheno_valid), ]

  # Modelo GBLUP con rrBLUP
  response <- mixed.solve(
    y = pheno_train[, trait],
    Z = geno_train,
    K = NULL,
    SE = FALSE,
    return.Hinv = FALSE
  )
  
  e <- as.matrix(response$u)
  response_predic <- as.vector((geno_valid %*% e)[, 1]) + as.numeric(response$beta)

  # Accuracy
  acc <- cor(response_predic, pheno_valid[, trait], use = "complete")
  
  # Normalized Root Mean Square Error (NRMSE)
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((pheno_valid[, trait] - response_predic)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  nrmse <- rmse / sd(pheno_valid[, trait], na.rm = TRUE)

  tibble(
    trait = trait,
    replication = rep,
    ntrain = nrow(pheno_train),
    nvalid = nrow(pheno_valid),
    accuracy = acc, # range: [-1 to +1]
    nrmse = nrmse # range: [0, >1] where: 0 high precision accuracy
  )
}
```

```{r}
GS_KAN <- traits %>%
  set_names() %>%
  map(\(trait) {
    map_dfr(1:300, \(rep) run_iteration(trait, rep))
  }) %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 
  mutate(pop = "KAN", .before = "trait")
```

### Validation

```{bash}
wsl
conda activate eva

export NXF_VER=23.10.1
nextflow -version
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64
export PATH=$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH
java -version

cd EVA

<!-- NXF_VER=23.10.1 -->

eva-sub-cli.py \
  --metadata_xlsx "/mnt/c/Users/LENOVO/git/quinoa-genetics/EVA/submission_info.xlsx" \
  --submission_dir "/mnt/c/Users/LENOVO/git/quinoa-genetics/EVA/" \
  --tasks VALIDATE
```

### Submission

```{bash}
eva-sub-cli.py --metadata_xlsx <metadata file> --submission_dir <submission directory> --tasks SUBMIT --username <webin username> --password <webin password>
```
